name: Fencing breeches
description: White knee-length breeches of tough padded cloth, with braces to hold them up and straps to close them below the knee. Made to turn a sword point in a bout, and good against scrapes.
notes: Folded on a shelf, 280 mm by 360 mm and 40 mm tall, waistband towards +z: white breeches with a padded front panel, black braces folded down over the top and strapped knee cuffs at the -z end. Slot `legs`, as the jeans have it. Protection is a judgement for padded cotton and nylon: fair against cuts and points, little against blows. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: High-carbon steel mail half-leggings
description: High-carbon steel mail, harder than the common kind, that wraps the front and sides of each leg and laces shut down the back of the calf. Lighter than full leggings, and they leave the feet free for boots.
notes: Shares the mild steel half-leggings' model with the mail in `steel-mail-dark`. Laid flat side by side, back up, hip towards -z: each half-legging is a tapered sheet of mail 820 mm long, 260 mm across at the thigh and 150 mm at the ankle, its two flanks meeting down the middle of the calf where leather edges are laced together in a zigzag, with a leather band at the top. CHECK VOLUME LENGTH: the reference gives the half-leggings rolled up tight; laid out flat they are far longer and their box far emptier. Slot `shins`, as the splint leg guards have it, so it straps on over trousers; it guards the whole leg. The reference gives no warmth. Protection is a judgement for mail with an open back, a little under the full leggings. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
